subject: Refunds working on new payments but rejected on older ones
body: Our ops team processes returns in a weekly sweep and about a third of them started bouncing back this month. Anything charged recently refunds fine. The older ones come back 400 with PAY_4013 and no other detail in the response. Example is pay_3Kd91xR2, request id req_8812fa04. We are on v3 across the board. I checked the amounts and they are well under what we took, and the payments show as captured, so I do not think it is an amount problem. Is there some cutoff on how far back we can go, or did something change on your side recently that we missed?
